messages:
marco: Quick ask — can someone run a short onboarding perf sweep for cerulean-7b on staging-dedicated? Need 8k context profile + chat-ish mix (128/512/8192) and a steady-state target ~100 qps. Goal: warm p95 < 120ms per token.

anna: Added to perf queue. Do you want cold vs warm cache numbers separated?

marco: Yes please. Cold vs warm, and streaming (first-token) latency as well. Also include kv cache hit metrics.

jess: tagging @perf-bot to schedule: 
`@perf-bot run bench --model cerulean-7b --seq 128,512,8192 --mix 60,30,10 --qps 100 --streams 8 --env staging-dedicated`

perf-bot: Scheduled run job id 1825700200 on pool-staging-dedicated-1. Estimated start in ~2m.

ryan: FYI — please include a routing fallback check to griffin-8b so we can compare cost/latency if capacity drops.

oliver: I'll collect NVTX traces and kernel-level stats. Remind me which counters you want?

marco: kernel-latency, nvtx ranges, memcopy timings, kv-hit-rate, batch-size distribution, and GPU occupancy.

perf-bot: Run complete. Quick summary:
- cold p90 token latency: 210ms
- warm p90 token latency: 95ms
- first-token streaming latency (warm): 46ms
- sustained throughput: 98 qps (95–101 qps during steady window)
- KV cache hit rate: 86% (after warm-up)
- OOMs/errors: 0

anna: Warm p90 is under the 120ms target — nice. Cold is high but expected. Any regressions vs last baseline?

oliver: Dropping a short diff from the profiler (high-level):
```
- warm p90 (baseline zephyr-6b): 100ms
- warm p90 (cerulean-7b current): 95ms  // ~5% improvement
- memcopy spike observed on gpu-3 at seq=8192 (~+30ms tail)
- batching distribution: mean batch 3.9, 95th batch 8.2
```

marco: Good — can we try an int8 quant run and limit max-batch to 4 to see impact on long-seq memcopy tail?

jess: Queued rerun (job id 1825700400) with `--quant int8 --max-batch 4`. ETA ~8m.

perf-bot: Rerun complete. Summary (int8, max-batch 4):
- warm p90 token latency: 110ms
- first-token warm: 52ms
- sustained throughput: 112 qps
- KV hit rate: 84%
- token-level quality delta vs baseline prompts: <0.2% (automated eval)

ryan: Throughput up and still within latency target. Small quality delta — looks acceptable for dedicated workload. :thumbsup:

oliver: Uploaded traces and full logs to internal staging bucket: https://s/internal/s/staging/bench/cerulean-7b/1825700012/ (nvprof, kernel-logs, batching-hist.json). Short note in the folder: memcopy pattern due to attention kernel padding; recommend switching kernel selector for seq>4k to reduce memcopy spikes.

marco: Perfect. I'll mark the onboarding checklist as passed on staging and open the model-catalog PR with the perf profile + recommended quant/profile settings. Thanks all :tada:
